Research and Context

Goal: the main goal is to earn additional revenue with changing the zero states ads for selling subscription on the app

Foundation: We want to redesign existing 'zero states' of ad-sources in order to increase sales of UG Subscriptions. Which means we are focusing on selling subscriptions with this existing sources but with the new approach and possible results. 

Research results

Previously we launched and got pretty poor results, yet we saw the perspectives of its kind of source.

Description of the Solution & Mockups

Iteration 1

Solution

Figma

  • We change the banners and interstitial with the inner banner selling access to UG Pro+
    • Apply plan Pro+ $39.99 / year with extended trial period (14 days)
    • new products for 14-day trial
      • ios: com.ultimateguitar.ugt.plus.1year7
      • android: com.ultimateguitar.tabs.plus.1year5
  • We change interstitial and banners everytime when:
    • User enters the screen with ad-source and don't get and ad to see
    • They get adfail event (уточнить ивент)
      • If there is no response on the ad to show → show inner
    • For banners also, if we see no ad OR zero-state (ad of Melodics) → change to new banners
  • We put the visuals inside the existing sources
  • After clicking on the banner or interstitial → show paywall with 'Go ad-free experience'
  • Apply logic only for free users without any subscriptions (exclude Edu and Sings singles)
  • after 5 second on interstitial → show close button


Current interstitial logic:

  • User enters the tab and at that time we check their data about last visit.
    • Interstitial conditions:
      • We show it only 5 times per day. With 180 sec gap in between these cases.
      • The logic renews everyday at 23:59
    • so there might be 2 cases:
      • we got the ad → shown to a user →  stored the last show time 
      • the as is not loaded → we got ad_load_failed event (this cycle is constantly processed at Android) → no additional actions, we try next time
    • then we repeat those steps until we meet the limitations above (5 times per day)
    • The cycle looks like:
      • no watcher marker → show ad → store marker → repeat 
      • at Android the server tries to show ad, but can not, due to it has no ad to show

Decision

RedFAIL

Even though ARPU is growing, we won't roll out the current solution yet. First, we'll test other alternatives to replace ads and try less generous offers. We want to avoid the novelty effect trap, where the audience quickly drops off. Instead, we'll implement a general solution first and then fine-tune it with offers if needed. Next project

Results

  •  increased arpu for 24% iOS and 13% Android
  • had problems with ex trials on ios: 21% of users tried to get 14d trials but got instantly charged instead 
  • iOS interstitials have 13% less conversion rate from trials than average

  • cannibalization

    • Android: 63% of earnings were cannibalized by reduced accesses from other sources

Conclusion

Decision 

RedFAIL

Results

  • 7.5% increase in arpu for iOS (vs 24% in previous iteration)
    • ~37% of interstitial revenue was from ex trial subscribers that is fixed now
  • and 5% non significanlty on Android (vs 13% on previous iteration) considering almost no charges from ex subscribers
  • but all matches if take into account all users with rights 4 and 5
    • iOS –  $0.021 arpu vs $0.018 in previous iteration
    • Android – $0.020 arpu vs $0.018 in previous iteration

Conclusion

  • despite fixing only one part with ex subscribers we got 2-3 times worse results than in the previous iteration
  • some users with rights = 4 or 5 were able to get valid trial without paying instantly and when we exclude them from the experiment we lost almost all of the revenue improvement

Next steps

  • We're not rolling out the solution yet; first, we're launching the next project

Description of the Solution & Mockups

Iteration 1

Solution

Figma

  • We change the banners and interstitial with the inner banner selling access to UG Pro+
    • Apply plan Pro+ $39.99 / year with extended trial period (14 days)
    • new products for 14-day trial
      • ios: com.ultimateguitar.ugt.plus.1year7
      • android: com.ultimateguitar.tabs.plus.1year5
  • We change interstitial and banners everytime when:
    • User enters the screen with ad-source and don't get and ad to see
    • They get adfail event (уточнить ивент)
      • If there is no response on the ad to show → show inner
    • For banners also, if we see no ad OR zero-state (ad of Melodics) → change to new banners
  • We put the visuals inside the existing sources
  • After clicking on the banner or interstitial → show paywall with 'Go ad-free experience'
  • Apply logic only for free users without any subscriptions (exclude Edu and Sings singles)
  • after 5 second on interstitial → show close button


Current interstitial logic:

  • User enters the tab and at that time we check their data about last visit.
    • Interstitial conditions:
      • We show it only 5 times per day. With 180 sec gap in between these cases.
      • The logic renews everyday at 23:59
    • so there might be 2 cases:
      • we got the ad → shown to a user →  stored the last show time 
      • the as is not loaded → we got ad_load_failed event (this cycle is constantly processed at Android) → no additional actions, we try next time
    • then we repeat those steps until we meet the limitations above (5 times per day)
    • The cycle looks like:
      • no watcher marker → show ad → store marker → repeat 
      • at Android the server tries to show ad, but can not, due to it has no ad to show
